title: Ammonia Yttrium Dilution Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Load the rest of the reagents onto the deck. Press go to run.

steps.title: Load ammonia tube
steps.instruction: Place a NEST 50 mL centrifuge tube containing 50 mL of ammonia into slot A1 of the tube rack; the full volume informs the pipette’s safe aspiration height.

steps.title: Load remaining labware
steps.instruction: Load the custom 99‑well plate, the custom 96‑well plate (positioned on a shaker), and a tip rack of Opentrons 20 µL filter tips onto the robot deck; ensure the Opentrons P20‑single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette is attached.

steps.title: Transfer ammonia to plate
steps.instruction: Using the P20‑single‑channel GEN2 pipette with a 20 µL filter tip, aspirate 10 µL of ammonia from the 50 mL tube and dispense into the designated well of the custom 99‑well plate.

steps.title: Transfer Yttrium to plate
steps.instruction: With a fresh 20 µL filter tip, aspirate 5 µL of Yttrium from the appropriate well of the custom 96‑well plate on the shaker and dispense into the same well of the custom 99‑well plate.

steps.title: Repeat for all wells
steps.instruction: Repeat the ammonia (10 µL) and Yttrium (5 µL) transfers sequentially for each of the 96 wells of the custom 96‑well plate, completing 96 transfer cycles so that every well is processed.

steps.title: Start protocol run
steps.instruction: After all labware and reagents are loaded, press “Go” in the Opentrons software to execute the protocol.
